"I — yeah. It helps, hearing that, as it were."

"It helps. Just — saying it out loud to someone who's actually listening. It helps."
"Still on that hard time."

"Look, forget it. You wanted something?"

"Thanks for... you know. Just listening."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"Has this changed you? Like, fundamentally?"
"The old you got you here. The new you keeps you here. Both count."
"I used to be a mushroom grower who worried about being on time. Now I worry about being alive. Same worry, bigger font. So yes — and also no."
"Still on how this changed you."
"Another time. The village needs me here."
"That can wait — it isn't going anywhere. What's on your mind?"
"I dreamed Alfredo was still here. Woke up angry at the dream. Stupid."
You show them Black Walnut — where it grows, how to tell it apart. Their eyes widen. "I never knew that."
"I braid grass while listening to plans. It doesn't bring anyone back. It just keeps my hands from shaking."
"Nobody says Alfredo's name right yet. We will. Give it a few days."
"They're already drifting away. "Later."

"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."

"About the pantry run — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"

"I oil boots on rest days for Alfredo, now. Feels right. Feels like the least I can do."

lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Alfredo Jain is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Alfredo Jain is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Alfredo kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Alfredo's gone." Aaron looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Alfredo." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Ruby blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Alfredo Jain, 41 days. The mantle passes to Ruby Mendelsohn.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Ruby Mendelsohn, 25 — a barber. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Green Thumb, Literally, Beard Moss, Cornucopia.
d41: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Gardener of the Living Garden." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Alfredo — and Alfredo is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Aaron, James, Zoltan and 1 more speak for Ruby — "Alfredo trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Ruby before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

d52: 📖 LEARNED: Generous Heart (Level 1). Donating gives 2x trust.
